quest.title: Peseng's Zaytun Peaches
quest.description: Peseng from Port Ormos needs ten Zaytun Peaches.

talks.objective: Give ten Zaytun Peaches to Peseng

dialogues.speaker: Peseng
dialogues.text: Yes! My wife needs Zaytun Peaches for cooking meals. Ten peaches will do for a couple of days.

dialogues.speaker: Peseng
dialogues.text: Do you have ten Zaytun Peaches?

choices.text: Here are the Zaytun Peaches you wanted.

response.speaker: Peseng
response.text: Too little peaches won't be enough, and I'll get scolded for that... Come back to me when you've collected enough of them.

dialogues.speaker: Peseng
dialogues.text: These will do. I hope she'll feel better after seeing these, at least for the rest of the day.

dialogues.speaker: Peseng
dialogues.text: Hmm... Which shop sells Zaytun Peaches? I can't remember...
